description: Create shared UI components in src/components/ui/ - reusable Lit elements (cd-toggle, cd-slider, cd-select, cd-keybind-input, cd-setting-row) that replace the repetitive implementations across views.
steps: Create src/components/ui/cd-toggle.js - LitElement with Shadow DOM. Import { html, css, LitElement } from '../../assets/lit-core-2.7.4.min.js'. Properties: checked (Boolean, reflect: true), label (String), disabled (Boolean). Renders a styled toggle switch (animated sliding dot) with label text. On click toggles checked and fires 'toggle-change' CustomEvent with detail: { checked }. Style with --bg-elevated, --accent, --border, --text-primary, --radius-sm, --transition. Self-register: customElements.define('cd-toggle', CdToggle).

Create src/components/ui/cd-slider.js - LitElement with Shadow DOM. Import from lit-core. Properties: value (Number), min (Number, default 0), max (Number, default 100), step (Number, default 1), label (String), unit (String), disabled (Boolean). Renders: label on left, value+unit display on right, range input below. Fires 'slider-input' CustomEvent with detail: { value: Number } on input. Style thumb/track with --text-primary, --border, --bg-elevated. Self-register: customElements.define('cd-slider', CdSlider).

Create src/components/ui/cd-select.js - LitElement with Shadow DOM. Import from lit-core. Properties: value (String), options (Array of {value, label}), label (String), disabled (Boolean). Renders: label + styled <select> dropdown. Fires 'select-change' CustomEvent with detail: { value } on change. Style select with --bg-elevated, --text-primary, --border, --radius-sm. Self-register: customElements.define('cd-select', CdSelect).

Create src/components/ui/cd-keybind-input.js - LitElement with Shadow DOM. Import from lit-core. Properties: value (String), label (String), placeholder (String, default 'Press key combo...'). Renders: mono-font input showing current keybind value. On focus, captures next key combination (Ctrl+Shift+X format) via keydown handler: builds modifiers array [Ctrl, Cmd, Alt, Shift], captures main key, joins with '+'. Ignores lone modifier presses. Fires 'keybind-change' CustomEvent with detail: { value: keybindString }. Reuse the keybind capture logic pattern from CustomizeView.js handleKeybindInput(). Self-register: customElements.define('cd-keybind-input', CdKeybindInput).

Create src/components/ui/cd-setting-row.js - LitElement with Shadow DOM. Import from lit-core. Properties: label (String), description (String). Renders: flexbox row with label+description on left, <slot> on right for any control content. Uses --text-primary, --text-secondary, --border, --space-sm, --space-md. Self-register: customElements.define('cd-setting-row', CdSettingRow).

Create src/components/ui/index.js - ES module barrel that imports all component files to register them: import './cd-toggle.js'; import './cd-slider.js'; import './cd-select.js'; import './cd-keybind-input.js'; import './cd-setting-row.js';
acceptance_criteria: cd-toggle renders a toggle switch and fires 'toggle-change' custom events
cd-slider renders a range slider with value display and fires 'slider-input' custom events
cd-select renders a dropdown and fires 'select-change' custom events
cd-keybind-input captures key combinations and fires 'keybind-change' custom events
cd-setting-row provides a labeled layout with <slot> for controls on the right
All components use CSS custom properties from the existing design system (--bg-elevated, --text-primary, --accent, --border, --radius-sm, etc.)
All components are self-registering via customElements.define() in their own file
All components use Shadow DOM (standard LitElement behavior)
index.js imports all component files to register them
verification: Verify all component files are valid ES module syntax (no CommonJS)
Verify all imports reference the relative path to lit-core-2.7.4.min.js
Verify each component file calls customElements.define()
Verify no external package imports (no @lit, no npm modules)
Run npx prettier --write src/components/ui/ to format all files
findings: Used bun 1.2.14 for verification (same as FEAT-001/002 - node not installed). All 6 files transpile cleanly. Prettier formatted cd-select.js (arrow function syntax adjustment). All components self-register, import from relative lit-core path, use Shadow DOM, and fire custom events with bubbles:true, composed:true.
